German airport worker dies of malaria after 'mosquito arrives on plane'
- Published
A Frankfurt Airport worker has died of malaria after a rare outbreak led to six employees contracting the serious infection spread by mosquitoes.
It is believed the mosquitoes arrived at Germany's busiest airport on a plane, according to German public health officials.
The remaining five infected individuals are receiving medical treatment, a spokesperson for airport operator Fraport said.

articles.title_original: Radiation link in flight attendant's breast cancer, French court finds
articles.title_zh: Radiation link in flight attendant's breast cancer, French court finds
facts_zh:
Radiation link in flight attendant's breast cancer, French court finds
- Published
A French court has for the first time recognised cosmic radiation as a factor in the breast cancer of a long-serving flight attendant.
Sophie Lainault, a 59 year-old former stewardess on Air France, sought to have her cancer recognised as an occupational disease, brought on by conditions at work.
This has now been confirmed in a landmark court ruling in the southwestern town of Bayonne, which said that cosmic radiation was one of three carcinogenic hazards arising from her profession.

all_titles.en: Radiation link in flight attendant's breast cancer, French court finds

articles.title_original: Indian jewellery ad pulled after backlash over actor's outfit
articles.title_zh: Indian jewellery ad pulled after backlash over actor's outfit
facts_zh:
Indian jewellery ad pulled after backlash over actor's outfit
- Published
An Indian jewellery brand has removed their new advertisement for the upcoming festival of Rakshabandhan, also known as Rakhi, after backlash over the outfit worn by the female lead.
The ad featured popular Bollywood actor Kriti Sanon celebrating the Hindu festival in which sisters tie a thread called Rakhi over their brothers' wrists.

Sanon, who is seen in a cropped top, skirt and a cape, addressed her critics on Tuesday night saying "culture and traditions are in a woman's heart, not in her neckline!"
The row started earlier on Tuesday after actor and BJP MP Kangana Ranaut called the ad "intentionally creepy" and asked why someone would tie a Rakhi dressed in a bikini.

all_titles.en: Indian jewellery ad pulled after backlash over actor's outfit

（亚太快讯消息）围绕持续紧张的中东局势对石油相关能源及原材料供应造成的不稳定影响，日本群马县伊势崎市近期对市内企业和团体开展了一项专项调查。结果显示，在参与回答的单位中，高达九成表示"受到影响"，要求政府出台补助金等能源价格高涨应对措施的声音十分强烈。

facts_zh:
Musk's SpaceX to build $100bn launch facility in Louisiana
- Published
Multi-billionaire Elon Musk's rocket company SpaceX has announced that it will build its largest launch site yet in the southern US state of Louisiana.

Construction of the $100bn (£73bn) project - named Starbase, Louisiana - is due to start next year, with the 125,000-acre (50,585-hectare) site expanding on the company's operations beyond its current Texas headquarters and locations in Florida.
It will be used to "support thousands of Starship flights a year with missions launching to Earth orbit, the Moon, Mars and beyond," SpaceX said on Tuesday.

（CNN） ロシアのプーチン大統領は、政府に対し国内の「重要インフラ」を一時的に接収する権限を与える大統領令に署名した。ウクライナ軍の攻撃が激化する中、民間企業がインフラ施設を保護できない場合に接収権限を行使するとしている。
ロシアとウクライナの双方が空爆作戦を強化する状況で、ロシア側が新たな措置を打ち出した形だ。ウクライナ軍によるロシア領土深部への攻撃は燃料不足を引き起こし、ロシア国民にとって戦争をより身近なものにしている。
ウクライナはここ数日、ロシア通販大手のオゾンや競合するワイルドベリーズに対する攻撃を強化している。そこにはロシアの戦争依存型経済を弱体化させる狙いがある。24日に発効した今回の大統領令は、新たな措置の導入について「ロシア連邦の重要インフラ施設の安全保障が一段と脅かされる現状に関連する」と述べている。

articles.title_zh: 【市场聚焦】玉米：预期扭转
facts_zh:
【市场聚焦】玉米：预期扭转
中粮期货研究中心
概要
Pro Farmer 调研美国玉米单产水平逆转了新季宽松平衡表的预期；连盘玉米前期“弱现实+弱预期”状态扭转至“弱现实+强预期”，主要受到小麦托市+远期进口谷物成本大幅提升带动，远月合约估值大幅修复。

上周CBOT玉米大幅走强，主要受到Pro Farmer 调研每日巡查结果，其中玉米单产远超市场预期以及8月USDA供需报告的单产预估水平。此外，俄乌冲突持续，也加剧了市场对黑海谷物出口的担忧。后期重点关注美国玉米收割前天气变化、9月供需报告单产调整情况、外围地缘战争风险溢价、以及关注中美领导人后期可能再次会晤对美国谷物对华出口可能带来的变化。考虑到8月供需报告已经将新季玉米单产大幅下调，本周有效突破500美分压力位后，后续有望继续冲高550-600美分。
Pro Farmer 公布全国产量预估：玉米产量 153.44 亿蒲式耳、单产 173.2 蒲式耳/英亩；大豆产量 45.72 亿蒲式耳、单产 53.3 蒲式耳/英亩。和USDA 8月预测相比，玉米明显下调，大豆小幅上调。按照USDA8月供需报告给出的160.13亿蒲，较本次Pro Farmer 预估玉米产量 153.44 亿蒲高出6.69 亿蒲式。

articles.title_zh: El precio del petróleo se desploma un 3% ante las primeras señales de distensión en Oriente Medio
facts_zh: - El petróleo cae con fuerza tras la señal de distensión de EE.

en Oriente Medio, que reduce el temor a una escalada militar y la prima de riesgo geopolítico
- El mercado seguirá atento al tráfico por Ormuz, la respuesta de China y otros compradores a las sanciones contra Irán y cualquier avance en la normalización diplomática
El precio del crudo registra hoy uno de sus movimientos más bruscos de las últimas jornadas.
El West Texas Intermediate (WTI) cotiza en 82,38 dólares por barril, un retroceso del -3,15% respecto al cierre anterior, tras haber llegado a tocar un mínimo intradía de 81,82 dólares.

articles.title_zh: Conflit au Moyen-Orient : la Formule E confiante pour maintenir Djeddah
facts_zh:
Conflit au Moyen-Orient : la Formule E confiante pour maintenir Djeddah
Alors que l'organisation des courses prévues par la F1, le MotoGP et le WRC au Moyen-Orient en fin d'année est incertaine, la Formule E affiche son optimisme quant au maintien du lancement de sa saison en Arabie saoudite en fin d'année.

Photo de : Simon Galloway / LAT Images via Getty Images
Le conflit au Moyen-Orient fait planer le doute sur les courses prévues dans cette région du monde au cours des prochains mois.
La guerre impliquant les États-Unis, Israël et l'Iran perturbe les chaînes d'approvisionnement, fait grimper les prix du pétrole et complique les déplacements.

Russia mobilisation fears grow amid reports of intimidating tactics
Military recruitment efforts are reportedly becoming more aggressive as Russia prepares for a winter offensive in Ukraine.

Owing to his illness, 26-year-old Sasha from Orenburg, a city in Russia close to the Kazakhstan border, has a Category V military ID, which under normal circumstances makes him ineligible for service.
But not during wartime.
